title: A heap is a complete binary tree stored level by level in an array
caption: No pointers are stored: index arithmetic finds the children (2i + 1, 2i + 2) and the parent ((i − 1) // 2). Every parent is ≤ its children.

frames.text: heap[0] = 1 is the root and the minimum. Its children are at 2·0 + 1 = 1 and 2·0 + 2 = 2 (values 3 and 2).
i = 1 (value 3): the children are at 3 and 4 (7 and 4), and the parent is at (1 − 1) // 2 = 0. 3 is ≥ its parent and ≤ both children.
i = 5 (value 5) is a leaf: 2·5 + 1 = 11 is past the end. Its parent is (5 − 1) // 2 = 2, which holds 2 ≤ 5.
